## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL; Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Energy strength vs broad weakness (XLE (1W: +4.28% | 1M: +11.24%) ABOVE TREND) while most sectors and small caps are lagging (IWM (1W: -1.65% | 1M: -2.55%) BELOW TREND), and major ratios read muted (SPY (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -0.80%) BELOW TREND).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Commodity-led reflation and rising energy prices (BNO (1W: +10.29% | 1M: +22.99%) ABOVE TREND) are the dominant tailwind, offset by tentative credit pressure: HYG (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -0.01%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -0.93% | 1M: -0.91%) BELOW TREND → HYG/LQD ↓ falling. Volatility shows easing on the month but is uneven: VXX (1W: -2.80% | 1M: -15.28%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-slightly tighter: TLT (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -0.67%) BELOW TREND → duration selling / yields ↑ rising, while dollar and broader liquidity measures are neutral per panel; HYG/LQD remain pressure points. Monitor credit spreads for a clear tilt.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy leadership clear: XLE (1W: +4.28% | 1M: +11.24%) ABOVE TREND; Tech is in RECOVERY (XLK (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -1.77%) RECOVERY) but breadth does not confirm broad tech leadership, so Style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US marginally lagging on the month: SPY (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -0.80%) BELOW TREND. EM mixed: EEM (1W: -0.03% | 1M: +1.74%) CORRECTION while China FXI (1W: -0.03% | 1M: -2.12%) BELOW TREND — no clear global rotation into risk assets.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation showing bifurcation: IBIT (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +20.34%) CORRECTION and ARKK (1W: -2.79% | 1M: +8.64%) CORRECTION have strong 1M gains but 1W pullbacks, while IWM (1W: -1.65% | 1M: -2.55%) BELOW TREND signals retail/small-cap risk — speculative flows are selective.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Broad commodity strength led by oil and base/refinery products: USO (1W: +10.84% | 1M: +21.91%) ABOVE TREND and PDBC (1W: +4.84% | 1M: +12.78%) ABOVE TREND, while copper CPER (1W: -1.32% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND shows uneven industrial demand. Precious metals pulling back into CORRECTION: GLD (1W: -4.40% | 1M: +7.65%) CORRECTION.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy dominant and broad: XLE (1W: +4.28% | 1M: +11.24%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +10.29% | 1M: +22.99%) ABOVE TREND and UNG (1W: +3.27% | 1M: +10.03%) ABOVE TREND — energy complex showing strength.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Energy (XLE (1W: +4.28% | 1M: +11.24%) ABOVE TREND) is consistent across timeframes. DIVERGENCE: XLK (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -1.77%) RECOVERY vs broad market ETFs SPY and IWM BELOW TREND constitutes a MINOR divergence.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to energy/commodity-linked strategies given clear leadership, reduce exposure to small caps and industrials showing weakness (IWM (1W: -1.65% | 1M: -2.55%) BELOW TREND; XLI (1W: -4.19% | 1M: -7.31%) BELOW TREND), and monitor credit (HYG/LQD) and duration risk (TLT).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +4.28% | 1M: +11.24%) ABOVE TREND and commodity proxies BNO/USO (BNO (1W: +10.29% | 1M: +22.99%) ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Industrials XLI (1W: -4.19% | 1M: -7.31%) BELOW TREND and retail/consumer discretionary (XRT (1W: -2.10% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Crude/energy USO (1W: +10.84% | 1M: +21.91%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +10.29% | 1M: +22.99%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Copper CPER (1W: -1.32% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND and gold GLD (1W: -4.40% | 1M: +7.65%) CORRECTION on near-term profit-taking.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 as a complacency/fear threshold (VXX (1W: -2.80% | 1M: -15.28%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling), HYG/LQD ratio around stress trigger (HYG (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -0.01%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling), and XLK/XLF spread for style pivot (XLK (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -1.77%) RECOVERY vs XLF (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -1.15%) BELOW TREND).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL; Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Energy showing strength: XLE (1W: +4.28% | 1M: +11.24%) ABOVE TREND and commodities BNO (1W: +10.29% | 1M: +22.99%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk is breadth and small-cap weakness—SPY (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -0.80%) BELOW TREND and IWM (1W: -1.65% | 1M: -2.55%) BELOW TREND; monitor XLK (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -1.77%) RECOVERY for a potential momentum pivot.
